Go to https://mlyfo.vercel.app/app/shield
Type "AdaK9zXw2LmQ8rTvB3nYc7HsP4kJe6FgD1oWu5Ra2Fx" into the "Paste a Solana, Ethereum or Base address" field
Click "Check address"
Assert the result says "Blocked"
